Self-hosted UMD bundle (chart.umd.min.js, includes @kurkle/color) so ThalVital
carries no runtime CDN dependency — locked-down hospital networks may block CDNs.
Loaded render-blocking (no defer) in includes/layout.php head() because pages call
`new Chart(...)` from inline scripts that must find the global synchronously.
